notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature you control, untapping the basic land.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Vishgraz.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.
